label: PRIOR_IN_TIME_2: Y is PRIOR_IN_TIME_2 to x when y is or occurs before x
definition: y is prior in time to x when y is or occurs before x. Within one and the same thing that passes from potency to act, the potency is prior in time to the act (ST I q.3 a.1 co.: licet ... prius sit potentia quam actus tempore). Priority in time is not simple priority (DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY): a thing can be first in potency and later in act while its potency still depends on some being in act. The existing TermSenseForks.PriorityFrame.PriorInTime field supplies the temporal relation used by ActPriorInTime and TemporallyFirstBeingInPotency; the latter refutes the temporal branch conditionally.
